object.name: evi.sustainverb~
object.digest: 16x16 FDN reverb with smooth sustaining effect
object.description: This is just Miller Puckette's 'rev3~' but with additional reverb features such as early reflections, filtering improvements and smoothing of parameters whilst maintaining the ability to forever sustain like the original. evi.sustainverb~ also includes multichannel taps of the FDN which can be very useful for surround-ish effects processing.
object.discussion: Tips: 1) turn early and highpass OFF, drywet to 100%, feedback to or very near 100% and damp low or 0% for 'forever sustain' effects. 2) turn early and maybe highpass ON and feedback between about 0.77..0.93 and drywet % to taste for more obvious reverb (room) type effects. For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.

messages.name: pattrstorage
messages.digest: In left inlet, pattrstorage messages to evi.sustainverb~
messages.description: Prepending the word 'pattrstorage' allows you to send any message pattrstorage understands to the internal pattrstorage object - you can recieve pattrstorage output via the far right outlet.

attributes.name: crossover
attributes.description: Frequency at which 'damp' filters take effect.

attributes.name: damp
attributes.description: Amount of damping in the FDN. 0=no damping, 1=maximum damping.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: early
attributes.description: This can be a switch or interpolated, both are smoothed. Add in early reflections. This makes the sound of the FDN more reverb-like.

attributes.name: feedback
attributes.description: This is the key parameter of 'evi.sustainverb~'. It controls the amount of reverberation in the system, but the higher the value the more towards foreverersustain the sound becomes.

attributes.name: gain
attributes.description: The gain in dB of the FDN recirculation.

attributes.name: highpass
attributes.description: This can be a switch or interpolated, both are smoothed. Add in a highjpass filter to the FDN. This makes the sound of the FDN more reverb-like and tames low frequency recirculation, but also curtails the ability to forever sustain.

attributes.name: smoothtime
attributes.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.
